notes: v1.1.117: (0) Email code picking is smarter: when a code mail's body carries several numbers (an order id, a date, a ticket number alongside the code), the code is now taken from the number sitting closest to a 'code' word (any of ~26 languages) instead of the first number found, so a wrong number is never submitted. (1) Account unlock no longer wastes time on a wall it can't answer. When Facebook's 'Confirm your identity' offers only phone/SMS/WhatsApp (no email), the unlock now bails the moment it sees that screen instead of clicking Next and spinning for ~3 minutes (LIVE: 177s -> instant). (2) Hotmail 'Open Browser' now actually signs in. Microsoft moved consumer sign-in to a new 'Use your Microsoft account' page whose email box is <input type=email id=usernameEntry> with NO name=loginfmt and a <button>Next</button> (no idSIButton9) - the autofill looked only for name=loginfmt, so the window opened on the login page and just sat there, never typing the address. It now finds the email box by type/id on the initial sign-in screen (still never on a verify/recovery screen) and clicks the Next/Sign in button whatever its markup - LIVE-verified against the real page. Then: email -> Next -> password, and if Microsoft rejects the password it falls back to the recovery-mail code (the headless token fetch already tries the password first and only then the recovery code). Carries 1.1.116 (screen_vision logger fix, bug_report scrub no longer freezes the UI) and 1.1.115 (website orders run on the www desktop viewer in both Mobile and Web Mode).
